Tom is a friendly bear, except when you can not concentrate. He will do his best to help you focus on something!

Just place your screen face down and focus on what you do.
A variety of white noise will help you focus more.
If you concentrate well, Tom will praise you.
You can change the session time in the settings.
You can reset the timer by pressing Tom's belly button.

"Bear Focus Timer is the ultimate tool for enhancing productivity and improving focus. With this app, you can concentrate on various activities such as studying, work, and projects. Customize the timer to suit your work style with its user-friendly interface and a range of settings options. Manage your goals, break times, work cycles, and more to maximize your work efficiency and support goal achievement. Make the most of your time with Bear Focus Timer and accomplish more in your tasks and activities."

Please keep in mind that Tom can also enjoy fishing when you are focused.
